Vendors · Edge Delta · Motadata ObserveOps

Edge Delta → Motadata · information-flow map

Structured rewrite of research notes gathered from Edge Delta docs (pillar-ab-implementation/Mapping ED to MD.pdf). MD here means Motadata / ObserveOps (E1–E11 fabric language). This page is a comparator map, not a decision to replace the Motadata build path. Companion hubs: ED AI Team hub · Our HLD · GraphWriter.

Edge Delta is a dual-layer product: Telemetry Pipelines (collect → process → route) plus AI Team (investigation / RCA). Motadata ObserveOps names eleven stages; Edge Delta names pipeline nodes and teammates. Same jobs can land in different boxes — diagrams below keep both vocabularies visible.
Edge Delta term Motadata / ObserveOps term AI Team / MCP Caveat / not 1:1

1 · Dual layer & two “graphs”

Telemetry Pipelines ∥ AI Team · Knowledge Graph ≠ Service Map ≠ MCP “graph” tools

Two Edge Delta topology products (do not conflate)

Knowledge Graph (AI Team)Service Map (Platform)
Purpose AI investigation context (owners, deps, blast radius) Live K8s service-to-service communication view
Inputs Event connectors (GitHub, Slack, PagerDuty, Jira, AWS, …) + K8s Service Map connector eBPF traffic via Kubernetes Service Map source → Edge Delta destination
Update ~3 min after connect; re-reconcile ~24 h Real-time metrics (rpm, errors, p95 latency)
Access AI Team → Knowledge · Topology View UI; not public REST/MCP Platform → Service Map
Motadata note Closest to estate relationships used in Localize — but vendor-private to ED teammates Closest to live communicates_with-style edges; not a full CI catalog

MCP tools named get_*_graph are time-series charts, not the Knowledge Graph. See tab 7 · MCP · KG.

2 · Actual Edge Delta pipeline flow

Sources → Processors → Destinations — not ingest.v1 / TelemetryEnvelope

Motadata PoC wire is ingest.v1 with ci_id, fact_kind, identity. Edge Delta agents speak OpenTelemetry-shaped items (logs / metrics / traces / events) plus signals. There is no CMDB bind at source.

4 · Multi-source SRE companion architecture

Your three enterprise sources → Edge Delta pipeline types → one AI Team

Cloud Pipeline

Agentless path for AWS streaming / Lambda / CloudWatch packs.

Gateway Pipeline

Aggregation layer: OTLP receive, dedupe, cross-source ops, optional fan-in from nodes.

Node + Coordinator

DaemonSet collects; Coordinator is control-plane only (heartbeats, leader election) — not a telemetry processor.

7 · MCP plane vs Knowledge Graph

MCP is not the ingest path · KG is not get_*_graph

Who can query what

DataAccessWho
Logs / metrics / tracesREST via MCP toolsAll agents (ED + external)
Pipelines / dashboardsREST via MCP toolsAll agents (with permission)
Time-series chartsget_log_graph, get_metric_graph, get_trace_graph, get_pattern_graphAll MCP clients — means chart, not topology
Knowledge GraphInternal teammate capabilityEdge Delta AI teammates only
Topology ViewUIHumans
Compared with Datadog Service Catalog / Dynatrace Smartscape (API-accessible topology), Edge Delta’s Knowledge Graph is a teammate-private context layer. Motadata Pillar B map/ is intentionally a published estate store — different product choice.

8 · RCA / investigation information flow

Detect → localize with KG (internal) → corroborate via MCP → package

Exact KG query mechanism is not documented (no MCP tool, no REST). Threads show “Knowledge references.” Treat internal KG access as inferred platform capability.
